Pins 1 and 6 share I/O1; pins 3 and 4 share I/O2; pin 2 is GND; pin 5 is VBUS. For a 5 V USB application, connect pin 5 to VBUS and pin 2 to GND; keep each I/O pair on one data signal and the other pair on the other data signal.
